newsitem.title: CHINA: China gas fields to produce 1.23 mln cu m/day.
newsitem.headline: China gas fields to produce 1.23 mln cu m/day.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjiang is planning to tap two natural gas fields that will eventually pump out 1.23 million cubic metres of gas a day, said an edition of the Xinjiang Daily seen in Beijing on Tuesday.
Xinjiang authorities had recently drawn up a plan to start development of the two fields in the Tuha basin in 1997, said the December 25 edition of the newspaper.
The Qiudong and Wenba fields were the largest natural gas condensate fields in the basin, with reserves of several tens of billions of cubic metres of gas, the newspaper said without elaborating.

The development plan called for the opening of several new wells and the overhaul of existing wells to eventually boost output of the two fields to 1.23 million cubic metres of gas a day, it said but gave no further details.
